title: File Manifest (v1.2)
description: Input file inventory with stable IDs, SHA-256 hashes, roles, page counts, format, and processing status. Immutable manifest_id serves as the version key for the entire review cycle.

manifest_id.description: Immutable version key for this review cycle. Generated once when the manifest is created; never reused.

files.description: Array of file entries. Each entry represents one input file.

file_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this file. Never reused across manifest versions.

relative_path.description: Package-relative path. Must not contain backslashes, absolute POSIX/Windows paths, UNC, NUL bytes, or '..' traversal.

role.description: File role in the review context. tender_document=招标文件; addendum=补遗/澄清; bid_document=投标文件; image=图片/扫描件; certificate=证照; other=其他.

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 hash of the file content. Strict 64-character lowercase hex; trailing newline rejected.

format.description: File format. Optional; pdf for PDF documents, docx for Word, image for standalone image files.

physical_pages.description: Total physical page count for paginated files (PDF, DOCX). Omit when unknown; do not invent or set to null.

printed_pages.description: Printed page count if different from physical (e.g. A3 folded). Omit when not applicable.

version.description: Document version or edition as stated in the source (e.g. 'v2.0', '2026-03-01'). Omit if not versioned.

processing_status.description: How well this file was processed: completed=all content extracted and verified; read=content read but not fully verified; partial=some content extracted; pending=not yet processed; failed=could not be processed.

logical_group_id.description: Groups logically related files (e.g. DOCX+PDF of the same document). Files sharing a group_id represent the same logical document in different formats.

notes.description: Additional notes about this file entry.
